question.text: Units of which type of Category III AIF scheme are eligible for listing on a recognised stock exchange?

answer.text: Only close-ended schemes, voluntary listing with minimum tradable lot of Rs. 1 crore
Both open and close-ended, with no lot size
No Cat III AIF units are eligible for listing

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 5.10, only close-ended Cat III AIF scheme units can be listed, and only after final close, with a minimum tradable lot of Rs. 1 crore. Listing is voluntary. The Trap: Open-ended funds, which already allow periodic redemption, are not eligible for listing. Cross-Exam Context: Same rule applies to Cat I/II AIFs (XIX-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Listing improves secondary liquidity but triggers LODR-style disclosures — weigh costs before recommending.
